systems.owner: MTNRA (ministry in charge of digital transition and administrative reform)
systems.tiers: public administrations that transcribed more than 2,500 procedures onto it

note: Loi 55-19 on simplifying administrative procedures (in force 28 September 2020) is not described as providing for public bodies exchanging data; the 2018 Royal Speech barring administrations from demanding documents another administration holds is a speech, not an instrument.
